nominal.method: design.json discrete LQR, Q = diag(300, 400, 400, 10, 8, 8), R = 0.3, on the EKF

mm_lqr.method: multi-model LQR, mean H2 cost over 320 models (256 corners, 64 draws) with delay, lag and the EKF in the loop; 8 gains, L-BFGS

gmf.method: Glover-McFarlane loop shaping, W2 = diag(sqrt 300, sqrt 400, sqrt 400) on [x, th1, th2], W1 = 1/sqrt 0.3, central controller at 1.1 gamma_min (observer form), own linear observer

gmf_tuned.method: Glover-McFarlane loop shaping, W2 = diag(sqrt 300, sqrt 400, sqrt 400) on [x, th1, th2], W1 = 1/sqrt 0.3 scaled for the best worst-case disk margin, central controller at 1.1 gamma_min (observer form), own linear observer

hinf.method: structured H-infinity: the 8 gains on the fixed EKF minimise the worst-case weighted H-infinity norm (push, drive disturbance, noise -> x, th1, th2, u) over the models (Nelder-Mead, active model set)

mu.method: mu-synthesis, D-K iteration with the fixed structure (8 gains on the EKF): K-step Nelder-Mead on the peak of sigma(D M D^-1) with frequency-wise D scales, D-step the complex-mu upper bound; LFT of robust_lin.build_lft
